description: This is a classic three-seater sofa upholstered in rich, brown leather. The design features deep button tufting on the backrests and seat cushions, giving it a luxurious and traditional appearance. The arms are rounded and well-padded, with decorative wooden accents featuring an ornate, carved design and metallic detailing. The base of the sofa is a dark wood with carved detailing and rests on turned wooden legs. The overall aesthetic suggests a sense of comfort, elegance, and timeless style, suitable for a formal living room or study.
